snippet.title: [Maimaimaigoen] Game Episode 5, Part 1 (English Subs)
snippet.description:
Translations by Ganbarebenji and Anonymous Piyo ( https://twitter.com/artwaltzed )
Turn on English subtitles by clicking the CC icon at the bottom of the video.

Happy New Year, demi! We're kicking off the year with our translated Episode 5 playthrough! 

There is additional dialogue that can be triggered when you control Kanata. Check out this video for the dialogue: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9QW5_QSeAII

Thank you for watching, demi!

--

Episode 5 - That Which Connects Us

Okada Yu and the children grow even more distraught as many of their friends leave Uropia at once, including the Game Overs during Bye Bye Slots. Meanwhile, a mysterious shadow appears to Kanata who is trying to escape with Hinata as the Bat Team. At the same time, the "treasures" of the remaining "New Goat Team" mysteriously vanish!?

Okada and the children venture into the new attraction, Sweeping Pool, in a desperate attempt to reclaim their treasures while pursuing Kanata. There, a mysterious shadow emerges, sending a jolt through Okada's mind.

What is Kanata thinking and who is this mysterious shadow...?

--

About Maimaimaigoen

Maimaimaigoen is a multidimensional story about the "growing pains of the heart" of 16 children and their nursery school teachers. It examines each person as an individual and accompanies them through the difficulties of living in today's world.


Introduction

Okada Yu, a new nursery school teacher, is on a field trip to Sanrio Puroland with his students.  As they're about to head home after a fun day, his vision suddenly distorted... They wander into the mysterious amusement park Uropia where they're confronted by a strange yet oddly cute creature called "Froggy Egg." To escape from Uropia, he and the children must challenge the park's attractions and collect 10 medals...

--
